commits.message:
big-words: support inline markdown formatting (#280)

Adds *italic*, **bold**, _underline_, and `code` to the rendered text,
with backslash-escapes for literal markers. Input is HTML-escaped before
markdown processing so script/HTML in the ?text= URL parameter cannot
execute.

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Big Words - interactive text styling web application (#279)

> Build big-words.html - a page which takes ?text= from the query string and shows that as big white text on a black background centered both horizontally and vertically
> 
> This is for  creating slides
> 
> If you double click or double tap it should show a form with fields to control the parameters - text= but also color= (text color, color picker) and bgcolor= (background color) and a few others that you think would be neat, maybe a gradient thing or drop shadows, with useful previews?
> 
> On submit that form should send the user to the page with ?text= etc parameters so it can be bookmarked
> 
> Make sure the form shows in a way that allows the rest of the page to work as a live preview of what it will look like

* Add big-words.html slide page with live-preview settings form

* Remove outline option, default shadow color to white

* Support data-hide-footer opt-out, set on big-words.html

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
